The Division of Computational Medicine in the Stanford Department of Medicine is advancing the future of health through data science, biomedical informatics, and interdisciplinary research. Our faculty are national leaders driving innovation that transforms complex data into meaningful clinical impact.

We are seeking a collaborative data science and machine learning professional to help build and evaluate real-world clinical AI, from extracting and curating EHR data (clinical notes, lab results, and other sources) to producing analysis-ready datasets and publication-quality reports and visualizations (for example ROC and precision recall analyses). Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. Data Collection & Organization

Support the development and maintenance of the Cost Data Collection Workbook required to capture source data by program, service, cost category, data source, and assumptions.
Gather, organize, and structure financial, HR/payroll, contract, licensing, procurement, infrastructure, and operational data provided by our client’s stakeholders.
Work with program contacts and business owners to collect data required for labor, vendor, consulting, licensing, maintenance, software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, miscellaneous, and overhead cost categories.
Maintain clear documentation of data sources, assumptions, definitions, and limitations.

Data Validation & Reconciliation

Validate completeness, accuracy, and consistency of source data received from agency systems and stakeholders.
Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and limitations that may affect the accuracy of cost determinations.
Support reconciliation of cost data to agency financial records and document unreconciled variances for review by the Principal Consultant.
Assist in validating allocation assumptions, cost drivers, units of measure, and service-level data inputs.

Cost Modeling & Financial Analysis Support

Support development of service-level cost models used to determine total and per-unit costs for each program or service.
Assist with analysis of direct, indirect, shared, and overhead costs across agreed-upon cost categories.
Support rate comparison analysis by organizing current rate, revenue, cost, surplus, shortfall, and variance data.
Help prepare supporting analysis for cost drivers, variance explanations, cost recovery gaps, and rate adequacy findings.

Reporting & Deliverable Support

Develop and maintain Excel-based analytical workbooks with formulas, documentation, and traceability to source data.
Prepare tables, charts, summaries, and supporting exhibits for the Full Cost of Service Report, Rate Adequacy Analysis, Forecast Analysis, and Executive Summary.
Support creation of reporting materials for agency leadership presentations and oversight briefings.
Ensure work products are organized, editable, agency-accessible, and suitable for review, comment, and final delivery.

Project Team Support

Work directly with the Principal Consultant to support day-to-day analysis, data requests, model updates, and reporting needs.
Coordinate with the Government Cost Allocation SME to ensure data inputs support approved allocation methodologies.
Support the Project Manager by providing status updates on data collection progress, data gaps, and analytical workstream risks.
Maintain organized files, version control, assumption logs, and supporting documentation throughout the engagement.

Strong experience working with financial, operational, staffing, vendor, contract, or budget data.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, structured workbooks, lookups, data validation, and model support.

Experience using Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Access, or similar business intelligence and data management tools.

About The Company

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.

Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. Driven: We deliver results in the right way.

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.

The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. Brief Description

Energize your Career at SECO Energy!

General Purpose of Job

The Grid Data Analyst position is responsible for providing information, assistance, and technical resources to cooperative system end users. This position helps the cooperative turn governed enterprise and electric grid data into trusted insights, reports, semantic models, operational metrics, automations, and decision-support products. This role supports utility operations by analyzing data from systems such as Outage Management systems (OMS), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Customer Information Systems (CIS), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Meter Data Management Systems (MDMS). This role works across business and technology teams to understand business processes, define analytical requirements, validate data products, and deliver reports and dashboards that are accurate, usable, secure, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards.

Minimum Required Qualifications And Competencies

The following includes the minimum job requirements and essential duties for this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Some job requirements may exclude individuals that cannot be reasonably accommodated or who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.

Requirements

Education

Minimum: Four (4) year bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in data analytics, information systems, business, finance, accounting, computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or a related field.
Preferred: Electric utility operations, Power system or distribution systems, Grid modernization, outage and reliability analytics experience. Coursework, certifications, or formal training in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, SQL, Python, Spark, Power Query, data modeling, data governance, business analysis, process automation and documentation.
Job-related experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis.

Experience

Minimum: Three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, operations analytics, financial analytics, utility analytics, process analytics, or related analytical work.
Preferred: Experience working with modern cloud analytics platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake, Qlik Talend Cloud or comparable lakehouse/warehouse platforms.
Preferred: Experience with Power BI semantic models, report development, paginated reports, Power Query, DAX, SQL, Python, Spark, documentation, data validation, source-to-target mapping, business metric definition, and cross-functional requirements gathering.
Preferred: Experience with Power Platform tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, and Copilot Studio, especially where analytics outputs trigger, workflows, approvals, notifications, or guided business process.
Preferred: Utility, cooperative, grid operations, outage, reliability, AMI, billing, or asset analytics
Preferred: Experience with OMS/GIS/CIS/MDMS/AMI/SCADA/ADMS data.
Preferred: Experience with feeder, circuit, substation, transformer, meter, service point, outage, and reliability datasets
Preferred: Experience with utility KPIs such as SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI, outage duration, restoration performance, load, billing, and meter-read quality.

Other Requirements

Ability to operate a variety of office equipment, including a personal computer, printers, copy machines and telephones.
Ability to work irregular hours for assignment completion and flexibility to change scheduling and report to work on short notice during emergency situations.
Normal work hours will be eight (8) hours Monday through Friday, between 7:00 am to 5:00 pm. Business travel between offices and travel may be required for training and development.
Successful completion of pre-employment background check, physical and drug screen.

Personal Protective Equipment
- No

Core Competencies

Safety: Follows safety procedures diligently, identifies potential hazards, and takes appropriate action to maintain a safe working environment.
Member Commitment: Provides exceptional service to members, actively listening to their needs and ensuring their satisfaction.
Honesty & Integrity: Acts with honesty and integrity in all tasks, maintaining transparency and ethical standards.
Work Ethic: Demonstrates a strong work ethic by consistently meeting deadlines and achieving high performance in all tasks.
Inclusive Culture: Contributes to an inclusive culture by respecting and valuing diverse perspectives and collaborating effectively with all team members.
Accountability: Takes responsibility for their actions and decisions, ensuring they meet commitments and deliver high-quality work.
Teamwork: Works collaboratively with team members, sharing information and supporting collective goals.

Job Specific Competencies

Business Analysis and Requirements: Elicits business needs, translates them into data and reporting requirements, documents acceptance criteria, and ensures analytical solutions align with business objectives.
Analytical Judgment: Applies structured analysis to interpret data, evaluate accuracy, investigate anomalies, reconcile differences, and communicate insights that support informed decision-making.
Data Governance and Data Product Management: Applies data governance and data product principles by supporting ownership, stewardship, metadata management, business glossaries, data dictionaries, certification, lifecycle management, usability standards, and access controls to ensure trusted and well-managed data assets.
Data Platforms, Architecture, and Modeling: Applies knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and modern data platforms, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Factory, Dataflows, and deployment pipelines, while leveraging data architecture and modeling concepts such as medallion architecture, star schemas, facts, dimensions, surrogate keys, and semantic-ready data structures.
Reporting and Business Intelligence Development: Leverages Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and M language expertise to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain dashboards, semantic models, and paginated reports that deliver accurate, reliable, and user-friendly business intelligence solutions supporting data-driven decision-making.
Data Quality and Validation: Applies structured data quality and validation practices to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency, including identifying and resolving data issues and supporting trusted reporting and analytics.
Automation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement: Uses Power Platform capabilities to support workflow automation, approvals, notifications, and business process improvement while identifying and implementing opportunities to enhance reporting, data quality, governance, and self-service analytics adoption.
Advanced Analytics and Transformation Review: Applies advanced analytical and programming expertise to evaluate, validate, and improve complex data transformation processes, ensuring analytical solutions are accurate, reliable, and aligned with business needs.
Responsible Use of AI in Analytics: Uses AI-enabled tools responsibly by validating outputs, grounding analysis in approved data sources, protecting sensitive information, and adhering to governance, security, and ethical standards.
Communication and Facilitation: Communicates complex data and analytics concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and facilitates collaboration across business, technical, and governance teams.
Grid and Utility Data Analysis: Demonstrates the ability to analyze electric utility and grid-related data to identify trends, assess system performance, support operational decision-making, and provide actionable insights that improve reliability, efficiency, and asset utilization.
GIS and Spatial Data Interpretation: Applies geographic information system (GIS) principles and spatial analysis techniques to interpret utility network data, evaluate asset locations and relationships, identify geographic patterns, and support planning, operations, and infrastructure management activities.
Outage, Reliability, and Operational Analytics: Exhibits the ability to analyze outage, reliability, and operational performance data to identify root causes, measure key performance indicators, assess system impacts, and support initiatives that improve service continuity and operational effectiveness.
Utility Source-System Knowledge: Demonstrates working knowledge of utility operational and enterprise source systems, including outage management, work management, GIS, asset management, customer information, and advanced metering platforms, to effectively acquire, interpret, and integrate data for analysis and reporting.
Grid Data Quality and Reconciliation: Applies data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance practices to identify discrepancies, resolve data integrity issues, and ensure consistency across utility systems, enabling accurate reporting, analytics, and operational decision-making.

The above qualifications and competencies for this position may be verified through a combination of education, experience, interview questions and technical skills exercise(s).

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of tasks and levels of work difficulty required of the position given this title and shall not be construed as declaring what the specific duties and responsibilities of any position shall be. It is not intended to limit or in any way modify the right of management to assign, direct and control the work of employees under supervision. Business Requirements And Data Product Definition

Partner with stakeholders to define business questions, metrics, dimensions, filters, report layouts, semantic model needs, drill paths, and acceptance criteria.
Translate business requirements into source-to-target mapping input, data quality rules, report specifications, and semantic model requirements.
Help identify whether a data need belongs in an operational report, Power BI semantic model, gold data product, certified platinum product, automation, or ad hoc analysis.
Document assumptions, exclusions, business rules, source-system limitations, and unresolved decisions.
Support domain-driven and data mesh operating models by helping define domain ownership, data product consumers, stewardship roles, and quality expectations.
Data Querying, Validation, and Reconciliation
Write SQL, DAX, Power Query M, and report dataset queries as appropriate to retrieve, validate, and analyze data.
Validate row counts, aggregate totals, distinct keys, required fields, duplicate records, date windows, joins, unions, and filters.
